strategiesPresented.name: Aggressive
strategiesPresented.description: Maximum parallel deployment — all tasks run simultaneously for minimum mission time. At least one spare drone per type deployed as a failure buffer.

strategiesPresented.name: Conservative
strategiesPresented.description: Reserve-preserving deployment — commits a buffer above minimum to absorb drone failures. Tasks run in series; slower but resilient.
